lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like distribution of circular high-luminance pixel clusters is visible on the lateral flank, with centroids forming distinct horizontal rows and vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a characteristic checkerboard-like grid of anchor nodes along the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transitioning from highlights on the superior edge to shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-luminance spots that are more randomly distributed and smaller in diameter than the ordered pattern on the lateral flank.
